name: cription
description: On-device transcription (Apple SpeechAnalyzer) and Cription notes. Audio is processed locally; tool results are returned to your AI client.
long_description: Transcribe local audio and video files with Apple's on-device SpeechAnalyzer (macOS 26+), and search or read the notes recorded with the Cription app. Requires the Xcode Command Line Tools (swiftc) for the first transcription.

tools.name: read_transcript
tools.description: Read long generated transcripts in pages without local file access.

tools.name: transcribe_audio
tools.description: Transcribe a local audio or video file on-device.

tools.name: speech_languages
tools.description: List supported and installed on-device speech locales.
